face_landmarker.description: MediaPipe FaceLandmarker (float16, 478 landmarks) — bundled and used by detection.py for face landmark extraction.

selfie_segmenter.description: MediaPipe Selfie Segmenter (TFLite) — bundled person/hair segmentation fallback in detection.py.

resnet18_bisenet.description: BiSeNet face-parsing model (ResNet-18 backbone, ONNX) — bundled per-region face masks in parsing.py.

retinaface_mv1.description: RetinaFace MobileNetV1 (ONNX) — bundled face bounding-box detector used by detection.py (primary path).

lama_inpaint.description: LaMa large-region inpainting model (ONNX) — not bundled. Advanced Retouch reports the Telea fallback until a verified model and controlled release URL are supplied.

sr_real_esrgan.description: Real-ESRGAN x4plus super-resolution model (ONNX) — not bundled. AIEnhancer.super_resolve uses standard Lanczos resize and reports that AI SR is unavailable until a verified model and controlled release URL are supplied.

denoise_nafnet.description: NAFNet-SIDD-width32 denoise model (ONNX, opset 17, dynamic H/W, RGB [0,1] NCHW) — bundled and used by enhance.py AIEnhancer.denoise (F7).
